# Raw source — do not edit

Verbatim copies of `red/assets/generated/battle/trainers/<name>.png`, one per
vanilla trainer class, all 56x56. Reproducible from any Red ROM via the
engine's own extractor, and a straight copy of Nintendo's art rather than a
derivative work — versioned anyway (since 1.0.0), so a fork doesn't need its
own ROM and extractor run just to start hand-editing a master.

This is the input to the crop-and-recolor script in
[`../trainers/README.md`](../trainers/README.md), which produces
`../trainers_new/` (the editable grayscale masters this mod's hand-editing
actually happens on) as its first pass. See the root
[`README.md`](../../README.md)'s "Assets and licensing" section for what
shipping this means for this repo.
